{{Top|leg}}
'''Duffel''' was a material used by the [[Alanciari]], the [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] natives of the continent of [[Alanciar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. The Alanciari used duffel to make [[Duffel bag/Legends|bags]] for holding personal effects.
